description.value: Big Wave Cafe is a surf-themed espresso bar and breakfast café on Peninsula Road in Ucluelet, fueling visitors with locally roasted coffee and breakfast sandwiches and bowls made with island ingredients. Founded by chef Chris Bennett, it is positioned as a launching pad for days on the beach or trails, located next to Howler's Restaurant near the Petro-Can Gas Station. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a casual, welcoming atmosphere tailored to outdoor adventurers heading into Pacific Rim country.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is a real, active surf-themed espresso bar and breakfast café at 1992 B Peninsula Rd, operating under owner/chef Chris Bennett. Online menu and ordering are referenced, supporting a takeout value of true. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those are null.
concerns: OSM name 'Big Wave Café1' contains a trailing '1' that appears to be a data-entry error; the business itself uses 'Big Wave Cafe' throughout its website.
Address (1992 B Peninsula Rd) is sourced from the website only — OSM address field is empty and could not be cross-checked.
No phone number found in OSM tags or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café with a functioning website, clear location, and food and coffee offerings directly relevant to touring cyclists fueling up for trail or beach days.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering services are also offered according to the website ('we also provide catering services — Let us come to you for your event').

Takeout.detail: Website offers an online menu and online ordering: 'Click to view the current seasonal menu or order online.'
